name: AIMFLEX
recent: Aimflex Berhad 近期持续进行股份回购，并在2026年10月公告执行主席Chuah Chong Ewe在闭市期有交易意向。公司截至2026年6月30日季度业绩显示营收和净利均同比增长。
notable: 公司近期多次进行股份回购。
执行主席Chuah Chong Ewe在闭市期有交易意向。
risks: 执行主席在闭市期有交易意向，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为2113.4万令吉，环比增长9.9%，同比增长29.2%；净利为410.7万令吉，环比增长41.7%，同比增长88.0%；净利率为19.4%，高于上一季度的15.1%。

recent_en: Aimflex Berhad has been continuously buying back its shares recently and announced in October 2026 that Executive Chairman Chuah Chong Ewe has an intention to deal during the closed period. The company's quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 showed year-on-year growth in both revenue and net profit.
notable_en: The company has conducted multiple share buybacks recently.
Executive Chairman Chuah Chong Ewe has an intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: The Executive Chairman's intention to deal during the closed period warrants attention to potential subsequent changes in shareholding.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 21.134 million, up 9.9% QoQ and 29.2% YoY; net profit was MYR 4.107 million, up 41.7% QoQ and 88.0% YoY; net margin was 19.4%, higher than 15.1% in the previous quarter.
